Mahanadi Coalfields set for Mumbai debut after $969 million IPO

The unit of state-owned Coal India lists Friday, the first IPO since the regulator barred gray-market price publication. Trading is set to start Friday. Source: Bloomberg

Reported by Bloomberg.
